## Checklist

- [ ] `bun run check` is green locally (typecheck, then tests).
- [ ] A test covers the change, and it was written before the fix.
- [ ] No new runtime dependency. (Dev dependencies are pinned to an exact version.)
- [ ] No key, token or `.env` content in the diff or in any fixture.
- [ ] If what leaves the machine changed, `SECURITY.md` changed in this pull request.
- [ ] If a user would notice the change, `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under the unreleased version.
- [ ] If this adds or edits a rule, the proposal's four parts are in the description: what it catches, regex or judgment, two examples each way, and a `seed` recipe for judgment rules.
